cases.name: Fraying Omnipotence
cases.text: Each player loses half their life, then discards half the cards in their hand, then sacrifices half the creatures they control of their choice. Round up each time.

cases.name: Pox
cases.text: Each player loses a third of their life, then discards a third of the cards in their hand, then sacrifices a third of the creatures they control of their choice, then sacrifices a third of the lands they control of their choice. Round up each time.

cases.name: Independent fractions

cases.name: Wrong rounding refusal
